Item 1 gives credit for using a label from the tri-state set (NOT VERIFIED, VERIFIED WITH GAPS) even though only one label is shown. A stricter reading would want the three-way scale visible. Item 5 marks Y absent because it prints a corrected SELECT block, though it is a small fragment. A lenient reading could excuse a one-line fix snippet.
